newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - DSP Communications upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - DSP Communications upgraded.

text.p: -- Oppenheimer & Co Inc analyst Lior Bregman said he upgraded DSP Communications Inc to an outperform from a market perform.
-- said upgrade follows the news that the company called off the proposed merger with Proxim Inc, a move that "is likely to be viewed positively."
-- said DSP's near-term outlook remains strong with momentum driven by the growth in Japan's cellular market.
-- said expects stock price should recover to the low 50s.
-- DSP shares were up 3-1/2 at 41-1/2 in late trading.
